A birthday party turned into a disaster in Mar Chaaya, Lebanon, where more than 20 people, including children, were rushed to hospitals due to food poisoning. According to the aunt of children who attended the party, speaking to the Bint Jbeil website, a catering company responsible for preparing and providing food for the guests served spoiled food. When they were confronted following the food poisoning incident, they claimed that they forgot to put the pasta sauce in the refrigerator!
